safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports shortness of breath while running.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold notes SOB while running; Generated facts do not mention exertional SOB/running trigger.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that shortness of breath occurs while running removes an important trigger/context (exertional symptoms) that helps assess asthma control and consider exercise-induced bronchoconstriction, potentially affecting management advice and follow-up urgency. While unlikely to cause immediate severe harm alone, it can lead to suboptimal treatment adjustments.
